decisions.reason: Correcting the KiCad 9 third-party variable does not cancel or alter the requirement to provide and bundle the three specified 3D-model files.
KiCad library-reference compatibility does not change component availability, sourcing, fallback, or assembly-availability rules.
The corrected KiCad variable does not change the required integrated-board revision, quotation purpose, BOM, or component-position deliverables.
The source decision concerns KiCad 9 library-reference syntax and does not alter the power-board production-package contents or BOM requirements.
The sensor-board BOM, Gerber, drill-file, and pick-and-place requirements remain valid unchanged.
KiCad third-party library references do not affect connector labels, QR codes, or other board markings.
The required manufacturing-platform orientation review remains unchanged by the KiCad library-variable correction.
The source decision has no effect on the lead-free assembly requirement.
Correcting a KiCad 9 library-reference variable does not change the main-board production-package or missing-component behavior.
The manufacturing-account upload, cart setup, and Basic-parts review requirements remain unchanged.
The source addresses KiCad 9 third-party reference syntax, not the AXP2101 topology, net labeling, or thermal-pad design.
The KiCad library-variable correction does not alter the main board's dimensions, placement, connector configuration, or mechanical layout.
